dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Magnificent Irodori Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: If you are here as an invited guest, please display your Invitation Letter, and one of our staff will help you arrange your event itinerary during this time.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: If you are just here as a visitor, please enjoy the festival. If you have any questions, please direct them here.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Magnificent Irodori Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: If you are here as an invited guest, please display your Invitation Letter, and one of our staff will help you arrange your event itinerary during this time.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: If you are here as a tourist or a visitor, please take care not to disturb those who are involved in installation works while the event is ongoing.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: If you have any questions, please direct them here.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: Do you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: This is the identification checkpoint under the jurisdiction of the Outlander Affairs Agency.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: Any outlander who wishes to stay temporarily at Ritou must have an Entry Permit ready. If you are looking to stay for longer, you also need a Resident Permit.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: If you don't have these permits, we can't really make an exception for you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Please stay safe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the procedure for going to Narukami Island...

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: If you wish to travel to Narukami Island, you need a Travel Permit. According to procedure, you must apply for it at the headquarters of the Outlander Affairs Agency...

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: ... However, if you don't have any special connections, it might be very difficult to apply for it.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: Yup, that's about it... I can't really say anything more than this. Please understand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So if I want to meet the Kanjou Commissioner...

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: If you wish to seek audience with the Kanjou Commissioner, you may send your name card to the headquarters of the Outlander Affairs Agency.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: The inspector at headquarters will pick out a guest worthy of meeting the Commissioner based on the status and causes of the applicants.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: ...That being said, you'd better give up on that idea if you are a commoner. Generally, outlanders won't have the opportunity to meet the Commissioner.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the procedure for going to Narukami Island...

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: If you wish to travel to Narukami Island, you need a Travel Permit. According to procedure, you must apply for it at the headquarters of the Outlander Affairs Agency...

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: In the past, if you didn't have any special connections, it might be very difficult to apply for it.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: Nowadays, all the affairs of Kanjou Commission are strictly supervised, so visitors should be able to apply for the Travel Pass easily as long as they prepare the required materials.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's this place?

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: This is the identification checkpoint under the jurisdiction of the Outlander Affairs Agency.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: With the abolition of the Sakoku Decree, the number of people entering and exiting Ritou has gradually increased, while the number of people coming to apply for short-term residential permits and goods exchange permits has increased as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: But since our restrictions are no longer so stringent, processing these applications has become a far smoother process. Oftentimes, only the most basic of documentation is required, thus resulting in the process being completed the very same day.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the procedure for going to Inazuma City...

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: According to the Almighty Shogun's edict, both Inazumans and outlanders may freely enter Inazuma City.

dialogues.speaker: Kageyama
dialogues.text: However, we are still to conduct the necessary examinations at checkpoints, just to be safe.
